run_contrastive_learning: run the 2-layer ReLU contrastive learning model with infoNCE loss using hydra config
create_Model: create a 2-layer linear model with ReLU activation and optional batch normalization
test_check_result: test the check_result function to compute concentration and coverage metrics from saved model files
compute_contrastive_covariance: compute the inter-sample and intra-sample contrastive covariance matrices for analysis
normalize_Normalizer: normalize a neural network layer's weights using F-norm or per-filter normalization
